subject: reasoning
question: Town P is to the west of Town Q. Town R is to the south of Town P. Town S is to the east of Town R. Town T is to the north of Town S. Town Q is to the northeast of Town T. What is the position of Town P with respect to Town T?
solution:
**Given: **Town P is to the west of Town Q. Town R is to the south of Town P. Town S is to the east of Town R. Town T is to the north of Town S. Town Q is to the northeast of Town T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09cade4d801b8c8ebdd4f6546979d5e6b3e89088b22a3ca116e1422df1a064f4.png] 

Thus, Town P is to the Northwest of Town T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
